slides.main:
What you wore
was a statement.

text: You wore a smiley tee to a dress-code club.
slides.sub: Bucket hat. Dungarees. A whistle around your neck.

text: The street moved to the floor.
slides.sub: Hardcore. Jungle. Acid Techno. No dress code needed.
UK Garage vs. free parties. Same decade. Opposite rules.
Cyber goth. Kandi bracelets. Glow in the dark.
Berghain. No logos. No photos. Anonymity as style.
TikTok spread it. Vintage shops priced it. Still a ripple from 1988.

text: You'll know what they needed that night.
slides.cta: Save this. Fashion is just the rave's answer to its own time.
